method: Banded Needleman-Wunsch on normalized word tokens (lowercase, punctuation stripped), band |dt_start|<=4.0s; match cost 0.25*|dt|, substitution 2.0+0.25*|dt|, gap 1.2. App words deduped on exact (word,start) first (2 dupes removed). Source: work/gemini_song_words.json (536 app words) vs SONG_WORDS.json (546 words). Gemini timestamps are model-generated, not CTC forced-aligned.
